entries.title: Matthew 16:1
segments: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him, and in order to test him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 16:2
segments: In answer he said: "In the evening you say, 'It will be fine weather, for the sky is red as fire';

entries.title: Matthew 16:3
segments: and at dawn you say, 'It will storm today, for the sky is red and lowering.' You know how to discern the look of the sky, but the signs of the times you cannot read.

entries.title: Matthew 16:4
segments: A wicked and faithless generation is seeking a sign, but no sign shall be given it but the sign of Jonah." So he left them and went away.

entries.title: Matthew 16:5
segments: When his disciples reached the other side of the lake, they had forgotten to bring bread.

entries.title: Matthew 16:6
segments: Presently Jesus said to them, "Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees."

entries.title: Matthew 16:7
segments: And they began discussing it among themselves, saying, "It is because we did not bring any bread."

entries.title: Matthew 16:8
segments: When Jesus knew it he said: "Weaklings in faith! Why are you arguing among yourselves, because you have no bread? Do you not yet understand?

entries.title: Matthew 16:9
segments: "Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many large basketfuls you took up?

entries.title: Matthew 16:10
segments: "Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many large basketfuls you took up?

entries.title: Matthew 16:11
segments: "How is it that you do not perceive that I did not speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees!"

entries.title: Matthew 16:12
segments: Then they realized that he had not told them to beware of the leaven, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

entries.title: Matthew 16:13
segments: When Jesus came into the neighborhood of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say that the Son of man is?"

entries.title: Matthew 16:14
segments: They replied, "Some say 'John the Baptist'; others, however, say that 'He is Elijah'; others, 'Jeremiah,' or 'One of the Prophets.'"

entries.title: Matthew 16:15
segments: "And who do you say that I am?" he asked them.

entries.title: Matthew 16:16
segments: So Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

entries.title: Matthew 16:17
segments: "Blessed are you, Simon, Son of Jonah," said Jesus; "for flesh and blood have not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven!

entries.title: Matthew 16:18
segments: "Moreover I say to you that you are Petros (a rock), and on this petra (rock) I will build my church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against her.

entries.title: Matthew 16:19
segments: "I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; and whatever you bind upon the earth shall be bound in the heavens, and whatever you loose upon earth shall be loosed in the heavens."

entries.title: Matthew 16:20
segments: Then he enjoined his disciples to tell no one that he was the Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 16:21
segments: After this Jesus the Christ began to show his disciples how he must go to Jerusalem, and suffer many things at the hands of the elders and chief priests and Scribes, and be put to death, and on the third day be raised again.

entries.title: Matthew 16:22
segments: Then Peter took him aside and began to reprove him, saying: "God forbid, Master! That shall never befall you."

entries.title: Matthew 16:23
segments: But he turned and said to Peter: "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling-block to me, because you are not intent on what pleases God, but what pleases men."

entries.title: Matthew 16:24
segments: Then Jesus said to his disciples: "If any man wishes to come after me, let him renounce self, take up his cross, and follow me.

entries.title: Matthew 16:25
segments: For he who wants to save his life will lose it; but whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.

entries.title: Matthew 16:26
segments: What will it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

entries.title: Matthew 16:27
segments: For the Son of man is about to come in the glory of his Father, and his angels with him, and then will he reward each one in accordance with his actions.

entries.title: Matthew 16:28
segments: Solemnly I tell you, some of those who are standing here shall not taste death, till they have seen the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
